systems.system: virtual sittings link to council chambers
systems.owner: Smart Zambia Institute and Zambia Information and Communications Technology Authority (technical support and facilities)
systems.tiers: council chambers in all districts (the report counts 116 districts), used for the committee's virtual public sittings between 2 October and 25 November 2025

note: A constitutional consultation report, captured in excerpt. It says virtual sittings were held in council chambers in all districts, with the Smart Zambia Institute and ZICTA providing the technical support and facilities that connected every district virtually; it does not say whether the link was the councils' own connection or set up for the sittings, nor that council staff work over it, so no fact is taken.
